title: Broader codebase hygiene: 27 ruff errors + 21 pre-existing pytest failures + ui-v2 build/lint cleanup
goal: Clear the long-standing pre-existing test/lint/build failures that accumulated across multiple sessions and were flagged by the operator's broader-check runs during #328 and #332. Restore green `.venv/bin/ruff check api workers scripts`, `.venv/bin/pytest api/tests workers/tests scripts/tests`, and `cd ui-v2 && npm run build/lint`.
scope: Fix 27 ruff lint errors (import-order in api/app/models/__init__.py + workers/orchestration/tasks.py + workers/orchestration/findings.py; semicolons in api/app/services/reports.py; unused imports across tests). Resolve 21 pre-existing pytest failures by either updating tests to match current code OR fixing code that drifted, decision per cluster documented in commit. Fix ui-v2 unused-vars + the real Property 'name' type error in MissionControlV3.tsx:1073. Align runner capability/contract metadata (67 valid vs 74 registered). Does NOT introduce new features; does NOT touch Mythos #325-#332 contracts.
generation_reason: Operator ran broader checks during #328 and again during #332 and found 21 pytest failures, 27 ruff errors, and ui-v2 build/lint errors that pre-date Phase 2/3 work and reside in must_not_touch files for the active Mythos tasks. Captured here as a discrete hygiene task so they don't bleed into Phase 4 scope.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md. Most appropriate execution slot is after Phase 3 closes (#333) and before / between Phase 4 tasks.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Hygiene only - lint cleanup, drift fixes, unused-import removal, test-expectation updates to match current code. Do NOT introduce new features, do NOT change runner contracts or planner behavior beyond what is necessary to make tests match reality.
constraints.test_strategy: For each failing test: either (a) the test asserts old behavior and the code is correctly new -> update the test, or (b) the test asserts correct behavior and the code drifted -> fix the code. Document the decision per cluster in the commit message.
constraints.ui_v2_scope: Fix unused-vars across MissionControl.tsx + MissionControlV3.tsx and the one real type error (Property 'name' does not exist on type 'Run'). Do NOT redesign components - this is parking-lot cleanup.
